brief.charter: A task-first booking flow that gives one consequential choice at a time while keeping confirmed facts continuously visible.

brief.representative_content: Topic; three local date/time options; IANA timezone label; facilitator; duration; remaining capacity; selected option; connection-error state; confirmation reference.
